command_line:
set -eu
cat > analysis.R <<'RSCRIPT'
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(DESeq2))
args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly=TRUE)
counts <- read.csv(args[1], row.names=1, check.names=FALSE)
layout <- read.csv(args[2], stringsAsFactors=FALSE, check.names=FALSE)
sel <- layout$Group %in% c("DMSO", "CBD_IC50")
design_df <- layout[sel, c("SampleID", "Group"), drop=FALSE]
sample_cols <- gsub("-", "_", design_df$SampleID, fixed=TRUE)
if (!all(sample_cols %in% colnames(counts))) stop("Sample IDs do not match count-matrix columns")
count_mat <- as.matrix(counts[, sample_cols, drop=FALSE])
storage.mode(count_mat) <- "integer"
colnames(count_mat) <- sample_cols
design_df$Group <- factor(design_df$Group, levels=c("DMSO", "CBD_IC50"))
rownames(design_df) <- sample_cols
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData=count_mat, colData=design_df, design=~Group)
dds <- DESeq(dds)
res <- results(dds, contrast=c("Group", "CBD_IC50", "DMSO"), alpha=0.05)
res_df <- data.frame(gene_id=rownames(res), baseMean=res$baseMean,
                     log2FoldChange=res$log2FoldChange, lfcSE=res$lfcSE,
                     stat=res$stat, pvalue=res$pvalue, padj=res$padj,
                     check.names=FALSE)
write.table(res_df, "deseq2_cbd_vs_dmso.tsv", sep="\t", quote=FALSE, row.names=FALSE, na="NA")
up <- res_df$gene_id[!is.na(res_df$padj) & res_df$padj < 0.05 &
                     !is.na(res_df$log2FoldChange) & res_df$log2FoldChange > 0.5]
down <- res_df$gene_id[!is.na(res_df$padj) & res_df$padj < 0.05 &
                       !is.na(res_df$log2FoldChange) & res_df$log2FoldChange < -0.5]
universe <- res_df$gene_id[!is.na(res_df$pvalue)]
writeLines(up, "up_genes.txt")
writeLines(down, "down_genes.txt")
writeLines(universe, "tested_universe.txt")
